يشتريان (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِيَانِ (yaštariyāni) /jaʃ.ta.ri.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# يُشْتَرَيَانِ (yuštarayāni) /juʃ.ta.ra.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
